VDOR

name: VDOR
title: Violent Death and Overdose Reporting (VDOR) FHIR Implementation Guide

resource.description: Bystander(s) Present values.

resource.name: VDOR Circumstances - Abuse or Neglect Led to Death (Death Abuse)
resource.description: Defines constraints on the Observation resource to capture whether or not abuse or neglect led to death (Death Abuse).

resource.name: VDOR Circumstances - Circumstances Category Observation
resource.description: Defines constraints on the Observation resource to capture items in the Circumstances category. This is a parent profile.

resource.name: VDOR Circumstances - Current Depressed Mood
resource.description: Defines constraints on the Observation resource to capture whether or not the decedent was depressed at or around death.

resource.name: VDOR Circumstances - Drive-by Shooting
resource.description:
Victim was killed in shooting where the suspect or group of suspects drives near the victim or target and
shoots while driving or uses a car to approach and flee the scene of a homicide but steps out of the car
just long enough to use a weapon.

resource.name: VDOR Circumstances - Gang Related
resource.description: Defines constraints on the Observation resource to capture whether or not the death was gang related.

resource.name: VDOR Circumstances - History of Alcohol Use (Alcohol Problem)
resource.description: Defines constraints on the Observation resource to capture whether or not the decedent has a history of alcohol use (alcohol problem).

resource.name: VDOR Circumstances - Problem at School
resource.description: Problems at or related to school appear to have contributed to the death.

resource.name: VDOR Circumstances Category Observation Codes
resource.description: Observation codes that fall under the Violent Death Circumstances Category.

resource.name: VDOR Composition Profile
resource.description: Defines constraints to the Composition resource in order to package VDOR related data elements as FHIR into a single document. This profile includes elements and extensions to support the NVDRS and SUDORS platform.

resource.name: VDOR Decedent
resource.description: Defines constraints on the VRDR Decedent profile to address the needs of violent death and overdose registry data.

resource.name: VDOR Demographics - Demographics Category Observation
resource.description: Defines constraints on the Observation resource to capture items in the Demographics category. This is a parent profile.

resource.name: VDOR Demographics - Demographics Social History Category Observation
resource.description: Defines constraints on the Observation resource to capture social history related items in the Demographics category. This is a parent profile based on the US Core Social History profile.

resource.name: VDOR Demographics - Homeless (at time of death)
resource.description: Defines constraints on the Observation resource to capture whether or not the decedent was homeless at the time of death.

resource.name: VDOR Demographics Category Observation Codes
resource.description: Codes for observations in the Demographics category.

resource.name: VDOR Document Bundle Profile
resource.description: Defines constraints to the Bundle resource in order to package VDOR (e.g. NVDRS and SUDORS) related data elements as FHIR into a single document.

resource.description: Extension for Drug Misuse.

resource.description: Extension for Types of Substance Use Disorder Treatments.

resource.description: Defines an extension for the Firearm profile to capture information related to the Firearm's owner.

resource.name: VDOR Firearm Serial Number
resource.description: Defines an extension for the Firearm profile to capture firearm serial number information.

resource.name: VDOR Firearm Stolen Extension
resource.description: Defines an extension for the Firearm profile to capture information on if the firearm was stolen.

resource.name: VDOR Firearm Stored Loaded Extension
resource.description: Defines an extension for the Firearm profile to capture information if the firearm was stored loaded.

resource.name: VDOR Firearm Stored Locked Extension
resource.description: Defines an extension for the Firearm profile to capture information if the firearm was stored locked.

resource.name: VDOR Gun Access Narrative Extension
resource.description: Defines an extension for the Firearm profile to capture a narrative on how the gun was accessed.

resource.name: VDOR Implementation Guide Custom Defined Codes
resource.description: Code system defined for use in VDOR Implementation Guide artifacts.

resource.name: VDOR Indicated Prescription Drug Misuse or Illicit Drug Use

resource.name: VDOR Injury and Death - Number of Bullets
resource.description: Number of bullets that hit the victim.

resource.description: Defines constraints on the Observation resource to capture whether or not the victim was in custody when injured.

resource.name: VDOR Injury and Death - Wound Location
resource.description: Defines constraints on the Observation resource to capture information on wound locations.

resource.name: VDOR Injury and Death Category Observation Codes
resource.description: Codes for observations in the Injury and Death category.

resource.description: Codes for observations in the Suspects category. This valueset will be populated as suspect observation profiles are created.

resource.name: VDOR Tox Findings Drug Obtained For
resource.description: Tox Findings profile drug obtained for codes.

resource.description: Tox Findings profile results codes.

resource.name: VDOR Tox Summary Carbon Monoxide Source
resource.description: Tox Summary Carbon Monoxide source codes.

resource.name: VDOR Tox Summary Test Results
resource.description: Tox Summary profile results codes.

resource.description: Defines constraints on the Observation resource to capture items in the Toxicology category. This is a parent profile.

resource.description: Defines constraints on the Observation resource to represent the Toxicology Findings section of NVDRS/SUDORS. This profile does not represent a standard clinical lab test and only captures the elements requested by the NVDRS/SUDORS platform.

resource.name: VDOR Toxicology Substance Tested
resource.description: Tox Finding and Summary profile substance tested codes.

resource.name: VDOR Toxicology Summary - Alcohol Tested Observation
resource.description: Defines constraints on the Observation resource to represent the set of Toxicology Summary section of SUDORS.

resource.name: VDOR Toxicology Summary Carbon Monoxide Tested Observation
resource.description: Defines constraints on the Observation resource to represent the set of Toxicology Summary section of SUDORS.

resource.name: VDOR Toxicology Summary Tests Value Set
resource.description: Observation codes for tests captured as part of the SUDORS Toxicology Summary.

resource.name: VDOR Treatment for Substance Use Disorder

resource.name: VDOR Use of Prescription Morphine
resource.description: Use of Prescription Morphine values.

resource.name: VDOR Violent Death - Wound Location Observation Codes

resource.name: VDOR Weapons - Firearm
resource.description: The VDOR Weapons - Firearm profile inherits from the VDOR Weapons category profile. This profile defines constraints on the Observation resource to capture information on a Firearm for VDRS records.

resource.name: VDOR Weapons - Weapon Type
resource.description: Defines constraints on the Observation resource to capture information on weapon type

resource.name: VDOR Weapons - Weapons Category Observation
resource.description: Defines constraints on the Observation resource to capture items in the Weapon(s) category. This is a parent profile.

resource.name: VDOR Weapons Category Observation Codes
resource.description: Observation codes that fall under the Violent Death Weapons(s) Category.

resource.name: VDOR-Current-Or-Past-Drug-Misuse-Example-01

resource.name: VDOR-Current-Or-Past-Drug-Misuse-Example-02
resource.description: Current or Past Drug Misuse - Example 02 - Multiple indicated drugs.

resource.name: VDOR-Treatment-For-Substance-Use-Disorder-Example-01
resource.description: Treatment for Substance Use Disorder - Example 01 - Multiple treatments.

resource.name: VODR Circumstances - History of Self-harm
resource.description: Defines constraints on the Observation resource to capture whether or not the decedent has a history of self-harm.

resource.name: VODR Circumstances - History of Suicide Attempts
resource.description: Defines constraints on the Observation resource to capture whether or not the decedent has a history of suicide attempts.

resource.name: VODR Circumstances - Incident is Random Violence
resource.description: The victim was killed by a random act of violence.

resource.name: VODR Circumstances - Person Left A Suicide Note
resource.description: Defines constraints on the Observation resource to capture whether or not the decedent left a suicide note. Note: This does not capture the contents of a suicide note, which should use the VDRS Suicide Note Contents profile.

resource.name: VODR Circumstances - Playing With Firearm
resource.description: Defines constraints on the Observation resource to capture whether or not the victim was playing with a firearm.
